clusters.canonical_title: TTL unit mismatch: seconds passed where setTimeout expects milliseconds
clusters.canonical_description: Config supplies TTL in seconds but setTimeout receives it as milliseconds, so cache entries expire ~1000x too fast. Both reviewers describe the same unit mismatch in set().
clusters.match_rationale: Different wording, same defect: the seconds-vs-milliseconds mismatch in the eviction timer.
clusters.single_fix: Multiply ttl by 1000 (or convert at the config boundary) before passing it to setTimeout in set().
